147-5231-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-5231-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-2301-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2301-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

628-6487-6495.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
An opponent controls seven or more creatures.
628-6487-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Evereth ability, and repeat from step 1.
Cast Canker Abomination by paying {2}{B/G}{B/G}.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
Canker Abomination dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
628-6487-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2073-6495-6522.description:

Activate Evereth by sacrificing Mandibular Kite.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2073-6495-6522.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

802-864-1144-1846-4503.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Sea Gate Stormcaller by paying {1}{U}.
Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, causing you to copy the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn with mana value two or less.
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.

Resolve both High Tides, adding an additional {U}{U} whenever you tap an Island for mana this turn.
Activate a Forest Island by tapping it, adding {G}.

Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning Sea Gate Stormcaller to your hand and untapping two Forest Islands you control.
Activate both Forest Islands by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.

Cast Sea Gate Stormcaller by paying {1}{U}.

Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting Eternal Witness.
Sea Gate Stormcaller triggers, copying Snap, with the copy targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Sea Gate Stormcaller to your hand and untapping two Forest Islands you control.
Activate both Forest Islands by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
High Tide triggers four times, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Resolve the original Snap, returning Eternal Witness to your hand and untapping two Forest Islands you control.
Repeat from step 12.
